hypothesis: v294 improved contextual exact-top3 likelihood but its standalone model omitted the two history sources that previously promoted v280 and v283. Adding their strictly-prior pairwise runner state and seven-day same-venue meet state to every historical training race may strengthen the independent expert without using parent probabilities as training input.
base_model: v294 contextual exact-top3 architecture and all v294 fixed raw/course features and hyperparameters unchanged

pairwise.ordering: build all features for a race_date before applying any result update from that date

current_meet.ordering: build all features for a race_date before applying any result or measurement update from that date

training.fold_rows: all strictly-prior raw races for each fold
stages: second among five conditioned on first
third among four conditioned on first and second
training.history_sidecars: build full 72,646-race chronological arrays first, then select train/validation rows

anchoring.optimizer: deterministic bounded scalar exact-top3 logloss minimization

promotion_requires: v283 delta below zero, date-bootstrap CI95 upper below zero, and v283 child-family Holm p below 0.05
